Latest WhatsApp TestFlight version references show Meta is working on an iCloud backup alternative for iPhone users. Details below.

WhatsApp is developing its own backup service

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp is developing its own cloud backup service for iPhone users as an alternative to iCloud.

The feature isn't available to WhatsApp TestFlight users yet, but WABetaInfo was able to enable an interface that lets users choose between iCloud and WhatsApp's own cloud service for backups. The interface promises 2GB of free storage, and the report notes paid plans could offer up to 1TB of capacity.

The report also notes that while users can choose whether WhatsApp backups on iCloud use end-to-end encryption, WhatsApp's own backup system will use end-to-end encryption by default.

Excerpted from WABetaInfo:

While a formal release date for the feature hasn't been determined, the report notes WhatsApp is also developing a Google Drive backup alternative for Android users. With work progressing on both platforms simultaneously, the feature could be officially announced in the not-too-distant future.
